hooks.command: jq -e '.tool_input.command | test("\\bgit\\b[^|;&\\n]*\\bcommit\\b|\\bgh\\s+pr\\s+(create|edit)\\b") and test("\\p{Cyrillic}")' >/dev/null && { echo 'Commits and PRs are in English. Rewrite the message in English. If the Cyrillic is not part of the message, run the commit or PR command on its own.' >&2; exit 2; } || true
